claim_scope: bounded retrospective comparison of already opened P06 and TRR-0006 panels; not fresh confirmation, a canonical benchmark replacement, or a training campaign
scope_exclusions: p06_full_record is excluded; its registered negative decision is preserved
no fitting, optimizer updates, checkpoint selection, compression, architecture or teacher changes
no P03 holdout, hidden records, unpublished TRR-0007 material, or new truth materialization

p06_natural.panel_role: complete published P06 natural evaluation panel
p06_natural.subset_rule: use all 256 published P06 records per domain in frozen order

trr0006_evenly_spaced_1of6.panel_role: modest deterministic subset of the already opened published TRR-0006 panel
trr0006_evenly_spaced_1of6.subset_rule: for each domain retain published selection rows at zero based indices 6*k for k=0..255, in their original order; no correctness, prediction, truth, or score field is consulted

common_geometry.observation_requirements: within each panel all methods use the same activation tensor, binary validity mask, position IDs, row order, and 127 scored positions for each domain-target cell
common_geometry.target_pairing: the same source index is paired across public_base and public_lora_2601; target conditions are not independent bootstrap records

p06_past_only.selection: published earliest-maximum validation_token_accuracy, validation every 100 including step 0; no re-selection

p06_positionwise_diagonal.selection: published earliest-maximum validation_token_accuracy, validation every 100 including step 0; no re-selection

enriched__affine_trained_diagonal_attent.decision_rule: joint affine path plus trained current-position-only diagonal attention correction; published loader-default dot product

enriched__affine_causal_h_attention128.decision_rule: joint affine path plus zero-initialized causal H_0..H_i attention correction; repaired cosine/QK-normalized implementation with cosine_scale4

prediction_matrix.description: score all six frozen states on every domain-target cell of both panels; retain both P06 seeds as separate prediction rows and average only correctness summaries within each source cluster
prediction_matrix.reuse: reuse existing P06 and TRR-0006 predictions only after exact state, observation, row-order, mask, position, geometry, and numerical-contract checks; cross-panel cells require frozen-state prediction, not truth

before_matrix: run the existing P06 qualification/native fixture for the P06 decoder path and verify a bounded prediction-ID replay against the published P06 artifact
run the existing TRR-0006 fixture-equivalence path for both retained states and verify raw-192 first-128, trimmed-128, and saved-prediction ID equality on its published fixture
verify the P06 and TRR-0006 runners bind the same FP32 readout E, bfloat16 activation input, FP32 decoder computation, bool masks, positions 0..127, chunk/batch geometry, and published tie rule
fail closed on any state, source, observation, row-order, mask, position, numerical, or tie-policy mismatch
fixture_and_provenance_gates.native_vs_port: label a path exact native replay only when its published runner and constants are unchanged; label a common cross-panel runner benchmark-compatible port and bind its equivalence fixture. Never pool native and port labels silently.
fixture_and_provenance_gates.prediction_freeze: write a create-only matrix manifest and freeze receipt after all 48 state-cells are complete and before any score/truth file is opened

metrics.token: micro correct count / (source records * 127), reported per domain, target, panel, method, and P06 seed; replicate-averaged summaries use fractional per-source correct counts
metrics.exact_clip: all 127 post-BOS predictions correct, denominator 256 source records per domain-target-panel; P06 replicate exact indicators are averaged per source before aggregation
metrics.paired_token: for each source, target, and scored position, compare correctness indicators; average P06 seed outcomes within that source-position, then report delta, gain mass, and loss mass without integer truncation
metrics.paired_exact: for each source and target compare exact-clip indicators after within-source P06 replicate averaging; report gain, loss, tie, and both/neither counts
metrics.reporting: each domain, target, panel, P06 seed, and replicate-averaged contrast is reported; percentages from different panels are never interpreted as a model improvement

uncertainty.unit: source record cluster; P06 seeds and both target conditions remain inside the cluster
uncertainty.resampling: within each domain and panel, resample source indices with replacement and apply the identical index draw to public_base and public_lora_2601; use the same draw for all methods and contrasts
uncertainty.interval: two-sided percentile 95% intervals for token deltas, exact deltas, and descriptive gain/loss rates
uncertainty.effective_n: 256 source records per domain-panel, not 512 seed-records and not 2*256 target cases
uncertainty.family: exploratory source-cluster uncertainty; no universal benchmark or formal multiplicity claim

cell_classification.benefit: token delta point estimate >= +1.0 pp and its 95% source-cluster interval lower endpoint > 0
cell_classification.harm: token delta point estimate <= -1.0 pp and its 95% interval upper endpoint < 0
cell_classification.uncertain: otherwise; exact-clip delta is reported separately

decision_gate.candidate_fresh_confirmation: only if the primary past-versus-retained-reference contrast is positive in both panels at the equal-weight panel summary, each panel token interval lower endpoint is >0, no panel has a harm-classified cell, and neither panel exact-clip point estimate is below -1.0 pp; this is a candidate only and triggers no new run
decision_gate.both_new_improve: if both P06 past and retained reference clear the same +1.0 pp panel-summary token criterion against the P06 diagonal control while their direct primary contrast is uncertain, classify as both-new/fitting-dependent and retain the reference pending a separately designed study
decision_gate.local_control_only: if P06 past improves over P06 diagonal under the panel criterion but fails the primary retained-reference candidate gate, retain the established reference
decision_gate.panel_dependent_or_uncertain: if the primary panel signs disagree, a panel is harm-classified, or the same-sign intervals remain inconclusive, do not promote either new default
decision_gate.priority: candidate gate, then both-new, then local-control, then panel-dependent/uncertain; all decisions are task-local and retrospective

known_differences_to_report: P06 states use two fit replicates (6106/6107), P06 H128 fitting with selected validation steps and a competent public affine direct path
TRR-0006 states are single retained enriched states from the earlier joint_fit_v1 and joint_fit_qknorm_v1 families; their fit support, selection, normalization, and attention parameterization differ
these differences are provenance explanations only; this task contains no intervention that identifies a cause

cost.protocol: if cost can affect disposition, use balanced warmed method ordering on both panels, report batch throughput separately from single-clip latency, and require exact prediction equivalence before comparing timing
